notes.title: HotFix (16.02.2018)
notes.notes:
We apologize for the errors with the pause menu. The error appeared in the release version and for some reason was not found when testing.
:::CHANGES:::
1) We partially fixed the bug with the pause menu.
2) Removed some items interfering with the gameplay.

notes.title: Release the game is coming.
notes.notes:
We will give everyone who wants to buy the game a 15% discount.

We will listen to your comments and soon after the release there will be an update in which we will try to change everything that you might not like.

We hope that you will like it.
